title: Partition: One Decision, Two Countries (COURSE CAPSTONE)
goal: Read and discuss an original text on the 1947 Partition of British India, running the reciprocal-teaching routine independently, reviewing cause/effect structure — and complete the course capstone: a synthesis task across all four knowledge units, a lateral-reading task on a Partition-era claim scenario, and a wrap-up marking the end of Level 6.
newToday: Nothing new in strategy/structure — this lesson consolidates the whole level and hands off to Level 7.
review: Cause/effect structure, all 6 strategies, reciprocal teaching (independent), syntax review (learner's choice), lateral reading (from L6.09/L6.10), writing-to-read synthesis.
time: 40–50 min (slightly longer — this is the capstone).
